prompt: Generate a funny joke that is more than 100 words long and appropriate for kids.
response:
Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a very curious little mouse named Mickey. Mickey loved to explore and was always on the lookout for new adventures. One sunny day, Mickey heard about a magical garden filled with the most delicious cheese in the world. Excited by the thought of such a feast, Mickey decided to set out on a journey to find this garden.

Mickey packed a tiny backpack with a map, a cheese sandwich, and a bottle of water. He said goodbye to his family and set off into the forest. After walking for what seemed like hours, Mickey came across a talking tree. "Excuse me, Mr. Tree," said Mickey politely, "I'm looking for the magical garden with the cheese. Can you help me?"

The tree chuckled and said, "Of course, little mouse! But first, you must solve a riddle. What has a head, a tail, is brown, and has no legs?"

Mickey thought for a moment and then said, "Is it a penny? No, that's not brown. A banana? No, that's yellow. Oh, I know! It's a coconut! But that doesn't have a head or a tail."

The tree laughed and said, "No, no, it's a coconut that's too big for you! The answer is a mouse, of course! You're so clever, Mickey!"

Mickey was confused but happy. "Thank you, Mr. Tree! But I'm a mouse. So, what's the answer?"

The tree laughed even harder and said, "You're right, Mickey! The answer is a mouse. But you're so small, you're the perfect size for the magical garden. Follow the path to your left, and you'll find it!"

Mickey followed the path and soon found himself in a garden filled with cheese of all shapes and sizes. He had the best day ever, but he also learned that sometimes, the answer to a riddle can be right in front of your nose—or in this case, right under your whiskers!

And from that day on, Mickey was known as the cleverest mouse in the village, and he always remembered that the best adventures are the ones you find in your own backyard—or in this case, your own whiskers!
